status: Proposed journeys, not implemented service promises

journeys.title: Explore as a guest
journeys.entry: First-time visitor; no account, photo or measurements required.
steps: Open Design your suit → see a complete studio look, brief service explanation and primary action.
Choose Start from a look or Start designing → create a durable guest draft.
Skip occasion or personal-photo entry → continue with studio model; optional steps remain accessible.
journeys.branches: Browser storage blocked: retain the in-memory draft, explain that resume is unavailable, and offer download. Loading never leaves an empty screen; unavailable featured look has an alternative.
journeys.outcome: Active guest design with stable draft ID; no order or request created.
journeys.acceptance: Guest reaches fabric and review without mandatory login, photo upload or tour. First edit has an observable saved/pending state.
journeys.evidence: SS01–SS02; avoid intrusive tours; Huntsman process clarity.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: six-step guest tool exists; durable server guest draft and entry looks do not.

journeys.title: Occasion, deadline and recommended looks
journeys.entry: Guest or returning client starting a design.
steps: Choose occasion, optional event date and intended use → reveal a small explained selection of looks.
Inspect a recommendation → see its actual fabric/style defaults before choosing.
Apply a look → populate design; keep Browse all available and allow changing the occasion later.
journeys.branches: Changing a recommendation must ask before replacing existing custom choices. An imminent event triggers concierge review, not an unverified delivery promise. Skipping date is allowed.
journeys.outcome: A chosen base look plus recommendation reasons and optional event context.
journeys.acceptance: Occasion changes the recommendations rather than only recording a label. Event readiness distinguishes delivery from required fitting time. Cancel leaves the existing suit unchanged.
journeys.evidence: SS03; Huntsman service-led entry; deadline complaints across review sample.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: occasion is recorded; recommendations and deadlines are absent.

journeys.title: Browse and filter the fabric collection
journeys.entry: Approved, sellable catalogue; unverified metadata excluded from filters.
steps: Open fabric collection → names, real swatches, codes and verified commercial status.
Apply colour/pattern/material/season filters or search → result count and active chips update.
Select fabric → specification and studio reference update together; personal image is marked stale if applicable.
journeys.branches: No matches: show active filters and Clear all. Missing attributes are not guessed. Unavailable selection stays visible with replacement choices and requires re-confirmation before ordering.
journeys.outcome: Exactly one selected approved fabric with catalogue version and source ID.
journeys.acceptance: Result count matches the actual list. Opening details and Back preserve filters/scroll. Late image results cannot overwrite a later selection.
journeys.evidence: SS02; HK02–HK04; PC02–PC04.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: three real fabric choices and photo changes; full catalogue/filter/inventory handling absent.

journeys.title: Inspect cloth and request a physical sample
journeys.entry: Client opens a fabric card; sample service must be configured before showing Request sample.
steps: Open details → large actual swatch, source ID and verified material/care specifications.
Choose cloth → commit it and return to the same collection position.
If offered, request a sample → show cost/address requirements, validate delivery information, and create a separate sample request.
journeys.branches: Unknown composition, price or availability is omitted or clearly awaiting confirmation. Closing inspection discards uncommitted choice. Failed sample submission preserves inputs and does not claim dispatch.
journeys.outcome: Selected cloth or a separately acknowledged sample request; sample does not order a suit.
journeys.acceptance: Swatch source matches code throughout. Sample status distinguishes requested, accepted and shipped. No personal address is requested for digital-only inspection.
journeys.evidence: HK04; PC04; real-swatch confidence concerns.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: swatch detail dialog exists; verified rich metadata and sample fulfilment do not.

journeys.title: Shortlist and compare fabrics
journeys.entry: At least two approved fabrics available; draft may already have a selected fabric.
steps: Add up to three fabrics to shortlist → visible count and removable saved entries.
Open Compare → show equally sized swatches and verified comparable specifications.
Choose one → update the suit, retaining the shortlist; return to browsing without losing position.
journeys.branches: A fourth addition offers replacement, not a dead end. Missing values are shown as unconfirmed, not zero. Removed/unavailable catalogue entries remain identified but cannot be newly ordered.
journeys.outcome: An informed cloth choice; shortlist remains part of the draft.
journeys.acceptance: Removing an item updates both tray and comparison. Merely inspecting an alternative never changes the selected fabric.
journeys.evidence: HK04 and PC04 information patterns; proposed NYONI comparison.
journeys.current_prototype: Absent in current local client tool; older v2 fabric-comparison experiment is not this implementation.

journeys.title: Choose silhouette and tailoring details
journeys.entry: Only tailor-approved base styles and combinations are offered.
steps: Inspect base style → see construction, included defaults and real reference views.
Select jacket/trouser detail → focused panel explains the choice and current value.
Apply → update compatible specification and relevant preview; Cancel returns without change.
journeys.branches: Conflict opens an explanation naming affected options and proposed changes. Confirm applies the complete change atomically; Cancel retains everything. Changing base style never silently resets bespoke selections.
journeys.outcome: A manufacturable configuration with explicit accepted dependencies.
journeys.acceptance: Every selected option maps to a production ID. Reopening a detail restores its committed value. Conflicts cannot survive into quote approval.
journeys.evidence: SS03–SS07; HK05; PC05–PC07; IN05.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: one jacket construction, three lapels and fixed trousers; no dependency engine or broader silhouettes.

journeys.title: Choose buttons, lining and monogram
journeys.entry: Approved accessory catalogue and supported monogram rules.
steps: Inspect actual button/lining samples → source code and applicable size/coverage shown.
Choose accessories → update design summary and supported detail views.
Enter optional monogram → preview supported text, placement and thread style before applying.
journeys.branches: Unsupported characters/length give specific help. If an interior image is unavailable, retain a real specimen and explain that placement is reviewed at fitting; do not pretend the closed jacket displays it.
journeys.outcome: Exact accessory IDs and validated monogram specification.
journeys.acceptance: Review/export and production record match the selected supplier components. A catalogue substitution requires explicit reapproval.
journeys.evidence: SS04–SS05; HK06; Proper Cloth selected-button mismatch review.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: real button/lining selection and text monogram exist; accurate interior/thread/placement rendering absent.

journeys.title: Add a photo with informed consent
journeys.entry: Optional full-body route; studio model remains available. No processing starts before an explicit action.
steps: Choose See it on me → see suitable-photo examples, output limitations, provider and retention information.
Select own/authorized photo → validate file type, dimensions, size, person visibility and quality; strip EXIF.
Confirm crop and consent → show an input preview plus Generate my preview.
journeys.branches: Blur, multiple people, hidden feet/face or unsupported image gives a retake reason. Invalid files are rejected safely. Cancel revokes temporary access and returns to studio. Selfie-only avatar is a separate future feature, never a body-accurate substitute.
journeys.outcome: A privately scoped person-image asset and consent version; no generated result yet.
journeys.acceptance: Uploading alone cannot trigger a paid generation. No public image URL, raw photo analytics or automatic marketing consent. Skipping photo preserves all garment choices.
journeys.evidence: Proposed; personal-preview plan and provider capability research, not verified competitor VTON.

journeys.title: Generate and inspect a personal preview
journeys.entry: Valid photo, approved complete garment reference and explicit generation authorization.
steps: Press Generate → freeze design/reference version and create one idempotent job.
Queued/processing → show truthful status, useful wait guidance, and supported cancellation.
Success → show current personal image, Original/Studio/Personal controls, exact garment details and approximation label.
journeys.branches: Provider refusal, timeout, quota or quality failure preserves original photo/draft and explains retry or studio fallback. Cancellation prevents a late result appearing as current. Do not invent progress percentages.
journeys.outcome: A customer-specific result associated with one immutable configuration.
journeys.acceptance: Job and image reads are owner-authorized. A rejected likeness/body/garment result is not silently displayed as successful. Generation never edits the underlying tailoring specification.
journeys.evidence: Proposed; no competitor review proves identity or fit accuracy.
journeys.current_prototype: Absent; provider has not been selected or benchmarked.

journeys.title: Change design after personal generation and compare looks
journeys.entry: At least one completed personal preview exists.
steps: Change fabric/lapel → studio reference updates immediately; personal image gets Previous design status.
Choose Update my preview → generate against the new immutable configuration.
Compare two saved looks → display each image with its own fabric/style labels and choose a design explicitly.
journeys.branches: Rapid edits or out-of-order responses cannot mislabel images. Generating variant B never overwrites saved A. A retained personal view shows its historical labels until replaced.
journeys.outcome: One chosen current configuration and a limited set of versioned private comparisons.
journeys.acceptance: Select A, request B, edit to C, then receive B: result B cannot become current C. Deleting an image does not delete its garment specification.
journeys.evidence: Current image-layer research plus proposed personal job lifecycle.
journeys.current_prototype: Absent for personal previews; studio switching exists.

journeys.title: Recover, replace or remove a personal photo
journeys.entry: Photo uploaded, job active, failed or completed.
steps: Open photo controls → see Replace photo, Remove photo and related result choices.
Replace → cancel/revoke older work, validate new input and retain the garment design.
Remove → explain which private input/results will be deleted, execute deletion and return to studio.
journeys.branches: Offline or delayed deletion shows pending status and retry rather than a false deleted receipt. Changing provider requires a fresh applicable disclosure/consent. Retention exceptions must be explicit.
journeys.outcome: Controlled photo/result lifecycle with deletion receipt or clearly pending deletion.
journeys.acceptance: Old image links expire or are revoked under the stated policy. Replacement cannot reuse another person asset or resurrect deleted output.
journeys.evidence: Provider-retention research; proposed privacy requirement.

journeys.title: Save and resume a guest design
journeys.entry: Guest editing on one browser; future durable draft service scoped separately from existing local storage.
steps: Edit → record draft version and visible save status.
Leave/return → offer Resume or Start new without silently discarding old work.
Resume → restore specification, shortlist, stage and supported views; revalidate changed catalogue/commercial data.
journeys.branches: Storage denied/offline: explain scope and offer download. Stale server/local copies require a recoverable conflict choice. Expired photo does not invalidate the garment draft.
journeys.outcome: Resumable design with clear local/server save scope.
journeys.acceptance: Reload reproduces committed values. Save is never submission. Invalid old schema migrates safely or preserves a recoverable export.
journeys.evidence: SS10; Hockerty restart complaint; existing local draft tests.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: same-browser local draft works; durable guest service and conflict resolution absent.

journeys.title: Create an account, link a draft and share a design
journeys.entry: Client explicitly chooses cross-device save or sharing; guest design remains usable.
steps: Choose Save across devices → sign in/create account through approved authentication.
After authentication → ask which guest draft to link; retain source until save succeeds.
Share → create a revocable read-only design link with an explicit audience and expiry.
journeys.branches: Login cancellation returns to draft. Account with an existing design requires merge/keep-both choice. Personal photos and measurements are excluded from shared links by default and require separate controls.
journeys.outcome: Owner-linked design or explicitly scoped read-only share; no recipient message automatically sent.
journeys.acceptance: Other accounts cannot enumerate or edit private drafts. Expiry/revocation works. A shared view cannot mutate the owner’s suit.
journeys.evidence: SS10 was same-browser only; account/share are proposed.

journeys.title: Returning member and verified entitlement
journeys.entry: Authenticated member; actual membership rules and source system configured.
steps: Open studio → fetch verified tier, benefit status and eligible options.
Choose included cloth or upgrade → display explicit inclusion, upgrade amount and final confirmation conditions.
Use annual benefit → reserve/redeem under approved policy with a visible receipt after success.
journeys.branches: Unknown/disconnected entitlement is pending confirmation, not Available. No remaining benefit offers quote/concierge route. Concurrent redemption is server-controlled and retry-safe.
journeys.outcome: A priced/eligible design and auditable benefit state; browsing alone does not redeem.
journeys.acceptance: No entitlement derived from frontend labels. Quote, checkout and staff view agree; failed payment/redemption releases reservations according to real policy.
journeys.evidence: Original NYONI membership intent; proposed business integration.
journeys.current_prototype: Absent; current tool makes no live entitlement claims.

journeys.title: First-time client chooses a fit route
journeys.entry: Client has a design but no verified fit profile.
steps: Open Fit → distinguish atelier fitting from guided remote measurements.
Inspect expectations → show what happens, what to bring and supported service locations.
Choose route → retain preference and continue to request/review without guessing a size from the preview.
journeys.branches: Unsupported location/service routes to concierge review. Uncertain client may ask for help without completing fabricated measurements.
journeys.outcome: Fit preference linked to design; not a confirmed appointment or approved body profile.
journeys.acceptance: A personal image never implies verified measurements. Client can change route without losing design or overwriting a previous profile.
journeys.evidence: IN appointment routes; HU process; PC08–PC09.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: fitting preferences exist; service directory and live requests absent.

journeys.title: Returning client reuses or updates verified measurements
journeys.entry: Owner has a dated, staff-approved fit profile.
steps: Open profile → see verification date, source and fit preference.
Confirm whether body/comfort preferences changed → reuse profile or start a revision.
Submit changes → retain approved historical version and show pending review.
journeys.branches: Outdated/incomplete profile requires human review under tailor-defined rules. Never silently apply unapproved revisions to an already released order.
journeys.outcome: Explicit profile version associated with the design/quote.
journeys.acceptance: Original values, revisions and reviewer are traceable. Selecting a stored profile requires authorization and cannot leak household/other-client measurements.
journeys.evidence: Proper Cloth repeat-fit accounts; Oliver Wicks measurement guidance.

journeys.title: Guided remote measurements and photo-assisted fit review
journeys.entry: Client selects supported remote service and agrees to its actual data use.
steps: Choose units and follow tailor-approved body/garment measurement instructions.
Enter values with diagrams and field-specific checks; optionally add fit/posture photos under separate consent.
Submit for staff review → receive requested clarification or an approved profile, never an automatic perfect-fit promise.
journeys.branches: Uncertain values can be saved with an ask-for-help flag. Unit switching is lossless within defined rounding. Images used for fitting are not silently reused for generative previews.
journeys.outcome: A provisional measurement submission, then an independently approved profile.
journeys.acceptance: Plausibility rules come from a qualified tailor. Incomplete data cannot become approved. Movement preferences such as sitting or performance are recorded explicitly.
journeys.evidence: HK profile entry; PC fit routes; OW/Sartoro qualitative reviews.
journeys.current_prototype: Absent; earlier v2 four-field experiment is not an approved measurement system.

journeys.title: Request, book, reschedule or cancel a fitting
journeys.entry: Actual service types/locations known. Request-first is the default until live calendar integration exists.
steps: Choose fitting service and location; inspect expectations and accessibility/contact needs.
Request-first: submit preferred timing/contact details → durable pending request ID. Live calendar only: choose available slot → review and confirm reservation.
Manage an acknowledged request/booking → reschedule or cancel with the correct confirmation state.
journeys.branches: Slot taken at confirmation: keep inputs and offer alternatives. A preferred date is not a reserved slot. Failed submission gives retry without duplicate request. Reminders require approved channels/preferences.
journeys.outcome: An acknowledged request OR an actual confirmed booking, labelled distinctly.
journeys.acceptance: Real calendar receipt required for Confirmed. Time zones and event deadlines are explicit. Cancellation updates both client and staff records.
journeys.evidence: IN07–IN11; HU03; Lanieri booking complaints.

journeys.title: Review the complete design and request a quote
journeys.entry: Design passes catalogue/compatibility validation; fit may be pending but visibly so.
steps: Review exact materials, construction, personal details, fit route, preview version and pending confirmations.
Edit any section → return to review with new dependencies and preview freshness reflected.
Request review/quote → validate contact and consent, create durable request and show receipt with next action.
journeys.branches: Changed material availability/terms requires acknowledgement. Failed send preserves draft; retry uses the same submission identity. No price, completion date or dispatch is invented.
journeys.outcome: An immutable submitted design version and staff-owned request.
journeys.acceptance: Request source IDs match export and staff view. Quote request is not purchase, redemption or booking. Download/print remains available independently.
journeys.evidence: SS07–SS09; PC specifications; IN Save-to-bag confusion.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial: editable review, prepare, print and JSON export; no actual submission.

journeys.title: Collaborate with a named concierge
journeys.entry: Submitted request assigned to an available staff member.
steps: Open request → see actual owner, status and latest message/action.
Staff proposes fabric/style/fit change → client compares the before/after specification.
Accept or reject → version decision; material commercial changes trigger a new quote for approval.
journeys.branches: No owner available: show awaiting assignment and real response expectation. Notification failure does not remove the in-app message. Unanswered case escalates under an actual operations rule.
journeys.outcome: An agreed design and fitting/quote next step with a retained conversation.
journeys.acceptance: No changes applied through informal chat alone. Staff sees the same current version; ownership transfer preserves case history.
journeys.evidence: OW guidance; SS automated-loop complaints; Huntsman continuity.

journeys.title: Approve quote and optionally pay
journeys.entry: Staff-reviewed quote with actual pricing, availability and terms; payment connection is separate scope.
steps: Inspect itemized total, tax/shipping where applicable, benefit/upgrade adjustments and actual fit/delivery conditions.
Accept the exact quote version; if offered, choose deposit/full payment and review the payable amount.
Pay through configured provider → receipt only after verified confirmation; connect order to accepted specification.
journeys.branches: Expired/revised quote requires reapproval. Declined/uncertain payment preserves design and avoids duplicate charges. Quote approval is not proof of payment or production release.
journeys.outcome: Approved commercial commitment and, when applicable, confirmed payment/order.
journeys.acceptance: Webhooks are idempotent and server-verified. Customer cannot pay an old quote to obtain new specifications. Discounts, benefits and refunds are auditable.
journeys.evidence: Proposed commerce; research did not complete competitor purchases.

journeys.title: Track production and manage an event deadline
journeys.entry: Released order with actual production milestones.
steps: Open order → see only real stages such as approved, in production, quality review and shipped.
Review expected next milestone and event/fitting buffer; ask concierge for clarification.
If risk appears → receive realistic alternatives and decide on changes before they are committed.
journeys.branches: Estimated dates are labelled estimates. Carrier delivery and garment readiness are different. Delayed events/production do not receive a fabricated automatic guarantee.
journeys.outcome: Visible, accountable order progress with deadline risks and decisions.
journeys.acceptance: Every milestone has a source/time. Staff cannot conceal an unresolved fit/quality issue by marking an item shipped. Event-risk communication is recorded.
journeys.evidence: SS/IN/OW/Sartoro deadline reviews.

journeys.title: Receive the suit and assess first fit
journeys.entry: Order delivered or collected; fulfilment receipt available.
steps: Open arrival guidance → inspect garment against approved specification and follow a short fit checklist.
Confirm acceptable fit or flag a specific jacket/trouser/detail issue.
If helpful, add consented photos and book/request a follow-up; staff acknowledges assessment.
journeys.branches: Carrier Delivered does not auto-close fit review. Missing/damaged garment routes to fulfilment support, not a measurement change. Policy dates use the approved commercial rules.
journeys.outcome: Client-approved fit or a linked open support case.
journeys.acceptance: Original garment specification remains visible. Fit-check photos are private and purpose-scoped. Acceptance does not silently waive rights outside approved terms.
journeys.evidence: Proper Cloth remake accounts; IN post-delivery gaps.

journeys.title: Request an alteration or remake
journeys.entry: Delivered garment has a fit/detail problem.
steps: Choose issue by garment region; describe symptoms and add optional supporting photos.
Receive case ID/owner and clarification request; distinguish fit correction from a manufacturing mismatch.
Review proposed alteration/remake, costs/coverage, logistics and timing → accept remedy; track until client reassessment.
journeys.branches: Repeated unsuccessful corrections escalate for human decision. Third-party tailor reimbursement requires explicit preapproval/status rather than an unexplained form. Event risk remains visible.
journeys.outcome: Resolved case or an explicitly escalated alternative, not an automatically closed ticket.
journeys.acceptance: Each correction versions measurements and links to the original issue. Follow-up checks actual fit before asking whether service was successful.
journeys.evidence: Proper Cloth two-remake positive account; SS alteration and IN reimbursement complaints.

journeys.title: Cancel, return, exchange or request a refund
journeys.entry: Client/order qualifies under the actual published policy; no blanket custom-garment policy assumed.
steps: Open order support → show eligible actions and explain exclusions before collecting a request.
Choose action → see specific instructions, return label/pickup where supported and any approval conditions.
Track requested/approved/received/refunded separately; receive confirmation only from actual service/payment state.
journeys.branches: Broken label or missed pickup has a direct retry and human escalation path. Pending refund is not Refunded. Cancellation after production release requires actual staff/policy review.
journeys.outcome: Auditable cancellation/return/remedy with accurate financial status.
journeys.acceptance: Partial refunds and exchanges reconcile with payments/benefits. No duplicate returns, lost labels or bot-only loops. Request cannot silently cancel unrelated garments.
journeys.evidence: SS returns-loop complaints; IN post-sale friction; negative PC review checks.

journeys.title: Reorder from a successful suit
journeys.entry: Client has an approved historical garment and fit profile.
steps: Choose Reorder → duplicate to a new draft, preserving history.
Review changed availability, prices, catalogue versions and profile freshness.
Keep the proven fit or request revisions; confirm new design/quote before ordering.
journeys.branches: Discontinued cloth offers clearly different substitutes, never an invisible replacement. New measurements do not rewrite the original order. Archived personal photos are not silently restored.
journeys.outcome: New approved order using explicitly chosen historical references.
journeys.acceptance: Equivalent supplier ID is verified rather than inferred from a similar colour. Current policies/benefits apply visibly.
journeys.evidence: Proper Cloth and OW repeat-order reviews.

journeys.title: Export or delete personal data and close an account
journeys.entry: Owner requests data controls; authentication proportional to the action.
steps: Open privacy centre → separate designs, photos/results, fit records and account settings.
Choose export or deletion → explain scope, retention exceptions and effect on active service.
Confirm → provide actual completion/pending receipt; revoke shares/access and handle vendor deletion requests where supported.
journeys.branches: Active-order retention is explained, not hidden. A pending downstream deletion is not called instantaneous deletion. Signed-out owner receives an appropriate identity-verification route.
journeys.outcome: Traceable owner request with scoped access/deletion and documented exceptions.
journeys.acceptance: Deletion and export do not expose another client. Cache, backups and vendor retention follow disclosed policy. Removing a photo does not accidentally cancel an order.
journeys.evidence: Proposed privacy design; provider retention differs from NYONI storage.

journeys.title: Coordinate wedding or group designs
journeys.entry: NYONI confirms group service and one organizer invites participants explicitly.
steps: Organizer defines shared style intent and event context → creates a group design brief.
Each participant accepts invitation and creates a private fit/photo profile while selecting permitted individual details.
Staff reviews group compatibility and per-person readiness; organizer sees consented status only.
journeys.branches: Organizer cannot access members’ measurements/photos or authorize purchases for them without explicit permissions. Missing participants and deadline risks are visible; one order failure does not corrupt others.
journeys.outcome: Coordinated but individually approved designs and fulfilment records.
journeys.acceptance: Permissions distinguish shared styling from private personal data. Group consistency is explicit without promising identical fit or shared ownership.
journeys.evidence: Wedding-order review pain points; proposed NYONI service.

journeys.title: Intake, assignment and concierge queue
journeys.entry: A sample/fitting/design request is submitted.
steps: Validate and deduplicate request → place it in a visible staff queue with receipt timestamp.
Assign a named owner → record acceptance and an actual next action.
Clarify missing information or transfer ownership → preserve conversation and version history.
journeys.branches: Unassigned/overdue cases escalate under configured staffing rules. Notification failure remains visible; no false emailed/delivered state.
journeys.outcome: Owned request and traceable next action.
journeys.acceptance: Every acknowledged request appears in the queue once. The client sees the same owner/status. A staff absence cannot orphan a case.
journeys.evidence: Customer support/communication complaints.

journeys.title: Approve catalogue materials and compatibility
journeys.entry: Supplier material or construction option is imported/changed.
steps: Review actual swatch, source code, production eligibility and verified metadata.
Approve dependencies, available views and material/price versions; flag uncertainty.
Publish a version → affected drafts/quotes are revalidated; withdrawn stock is not silently substituted.
journeys.branches: OCR ambiguity cannot become a confirmed SKU. Missing image does not invent garment coverage. Updates to accepted quotes require controlled reapproval.
journeys.outcome: Tailor-approved catalogue and a complete audit trail.
journeys.acceptance: Every exposed option has provenance and an owner. Only supported combinations can be submitted as approved; all imagery is versioned.
journeys.evidence: PC compatibility and selected-component complaints; original PDFs.
journeys.current_prototype: Partial extraction exists; approval/availability tools absent.

journeys.title: Review measurements and approve fit profiles
journeys.entry: Provisional measurements/photos or a revision is awaiting review.
steps: Inspect units, body-vs-garment semantics, provenance and client comfort goals.
Request clarification or approve corrected values with reason and reviewer.
Link an immutable approved profile version to the design/order; retain superseded versions.
journeys.branches: Image-only or uncalibrated estimates cannot be promoted to verified measurements. Production already released requires a change request, not silent editing.
journeys.outcome: Approved profile or clear client action required.
journeys.acceptance: Only authorized fitting staff can approve. Measurement revisions explain the difference and cannot overwrite a different order/client profile.
journeys.evidence: PC/OW/Sartoro fit-review findings.

journeys.title: Quote, entitlement and commercial review
journeys.entry: A valid design and applicable business policies are available.
steps: Check actual availability, construction feasibility, fit status and event timing.
Resolve real membership eligibility and price breakdown; create expiring quote version.
Send for explicit client approval; revisions supersede earlier versions without losing history.
journeys.branches: Unknown lead time or entitlement stays pending. An unavailable material produces an explicit alternative proposal. No invented discount, tax or annual benefit.
journeys.outcome: Approved quote or a client-visible clarification request.
journeys.acceptance: Client and staff totals match. Financial and entitlement adjustments have authorized owners and cannot be changed by client-side state.
journeys.evidence: SS information clarity; NYONI membership requirements.

journeys.title: Release production and handle specification changes
journeys.entry: Client accepted the current quote and prerequisites are satisfied.
steps: Perform production preflight against the approved specification/profile and applicable payment/benefit state.
Release immutable order package with exact IDs and accepted construction instructions.
Handle later change requests with feasibility, timing and commercial impact before new release.
journeys.branches: Personal preview never becomes a measurement or BOM authority. Version mismatch blocks release. Late changes are not promised before maker confirmation.
journeys.outcome: One controlled production version and auditable changes.
journeys.acceptance: Factory/tailor receives the same IDs approved by client. A changed quote or photo result cannot automatically mutate a released order.
journeys.evidence: Specification-mismatch reviews; proposed operational control.

journeys.title: Operate and review personal-preview jobs
journeys.entry: Consented generation job queued or flagged by a client/quality check.
steps: Verify owner, design asset version, eligible input and remaining generation budget.
Run bounded provider job → inspect output quality criteria and flag unusable results.
Deliver approved result, request retake or provide studio fallback; record operational metrics without raw-photo logging.
journeys.branches: Provider outage, duplicate callbacks, stale result or deleted photo prevents current-result delivery. Staff image access is restricted and logged, not open to every concierge.
journeys.outcome: Controlled personal-result lifecycle with accountable failure handling.
journeys.acceptance: No cross-client cache or access. Identity/body/construction failures are not disguised as success. Provider deletion limitations remain disclosed.
journeys.evidence: Proposed personal-preview quality/privacy plan.

journeys.title: Resolve aftercare, returns and payment remedies
journeys.entry: Client opens a fit, quality, shipment or financial case.
steps: Triage issue and retrieve original accepted specification, profile, delivery and prior corrections.
Assign remedy with actual coverage, deadline, logistics and approval owner.
Confirm fulfilment/refund from the responsible system, then invite client reassessment and close or escalate.
journeys.branches: Repeated fit failures, missing labels, unreceived reimbursements or unresolved refunds escalate to a person with authority. Customer must not repeatedly re-enter the same case.
journeys.outcome: Accountable resolution with accurate financial/fit status.
journeys.acceptance: Refund confirmation is distinct from approval; reopened cases retain history. Staff cannot mark payment refunded on an unverified message.
journeys.evidence: SS support loops; PC remakes; IN reimbursement complaints.

journeys.title: Manage access, privacy and deletion requests
journeys.release: Connected service; required before photo pilot
journeys.entry: Owner makes a data request or a retention job is due.
steps: Verify requester and enumerate scoped designs, photos, shares, jobs and fit records.
Apply deletion/export rules and valid retention exceptions; revoke active links and cancel affected jobs.
Track downstream provider requests and notify owner of actual completion/pending exceptions.
journeys.branches: Failed storage/vendor deletion is retried/escalated, not hidden. Access investigations preserve necessary audit evidence without uncontrolled image copies.
journeys.outcome: Completed owner request or transparent pending state.
journeys.acceptance: Cross-account access tests, staff role checks, expiry and deletion checks pass before pilot. Legal/policy exceptions require documented review.
journeys.evidence: Photo-provider retention research; proposed service control.

screens.name: Privacy / export / photo removal / account closure
